title: Delta
description: Incremental change-set IPC message. Normative form (protocol.md § IPC) is the EXTERNALLY-TAGGED envelope {"Delta": {...}} — not a "type" discriminant. Each DeltaOp variant is itself externally tagged by its PascalCase name (single-key object). Serialized value bytes are JSON arrays of u8, not base64. NodeAdd's optional `key` (NodeKey) is omitted in JSON when absent.

Delta.description: Incremental change set: ordered ops that take the receiver from `base_epoch` to `epoch`.

base_epoch.description: Epoch this delta applies to (must equal the receiver's last_epoch).

epoch.description: New epoch, >= base_epoch + 1. Usually base_epoch + 1; a multi-epoch-span delta has epoch > base_epoch + 1 (epoch - base_epoch = accepted-event span). See protocol.md § Multi-epoch-span delta.

DeltaOp.description: One incremental graph mutation. Externally tagged: a single-key object whose key is the PascalCase variant name.

oneOf.title: CellSet
oneOf.description: A source cell was changed to `payload`.

oneOf.title: SlotValue
oneOf.description: A lazily recomputed slot published a concrete value.

oneOf.title: Invalidate
oneOf.description: A node was dirtied without publishing a concrete value.

oneOf.title: QueuePush
oneOf.description: Op-log delta form for a QueueCell node: append `payload` to the tail. The op-log delta is the incremental counterpart to the storage-snapshot form (cell-model.md § Wire and snapshot shape); a run of same-direction QueuePush ops fuses into one multi-epoch batch Delta (protocol.md § Backpressure & outbox coalescing).

oneOf.title: QueuePop
oneOf.description: Op-log delta form for a QueueCell node: remove the head. Carries no value (the popped element is determined by ordered replay); a re-delivered pop is Ignored by the epoch gap rule. Crosses the wire only when consumption is authoritatively replicated (mirror sync); in the default producer→consumer sync the remote consumer's pops are local. A QueuePop/QueueClose is a fusion boundary (order-sensitive).

oneOf.title: QueueClose
oneOf.description: Op-log delta form for a QueueCell node: mark closed (idempotent, terminal — Closed is distinct from Empty). A fusion boundary.

CellSetBody.description: Body of a `CellSet` or `QueuePush` op: the node and its new value or appended element.

payload.description: Value, inline or by blob descriptor.

SlotValueBody.description: Body of a `SlotValue` op: the slot and the value it published.

payload.description: Value, inline or by blob descriptor.

NodeBody.description: Body of an op that names only its node (`Invalidate`, `NodeRemove`, `QueuePop`, `QueueClose`).

NodeAddBody.description: Body of a `NodeAdd` op: the new node, its type tag and its initial state.

type_tag.description: Binding-defined type tag of the new node.

key.description: Optional wire-stable keyed address. A conforming ENCODER omits it when absent; an explicit null is also wire-valid and a decoder MUST read both forms as absent (protocol.md § NodeKey, #lzkeynullstrict). This carried a bare NodeKey $ref until that audit, which made a frame the spec now requires decoders to accept schema-invalid.

EdgeBody.description: Body of an `EdgeAdd` or `EdgeRemove` op: one dependency edge.
